The visible forelegs/paws appear sturdy and proportionate, consistent with a muscular build, though full straightness cannot be fully assessed in a resting pose.

This may be biological (cataracts) or a subtle generation artifact in rendering eye moisture.
Slight softness/bleeding between the paw fur and the complex background pattern, likely due to depth-of-field simulation or minor edge blending issues common in AI generations.
